sentences.en: Newspaper stands are scattered here and there throughout the city.
sentences.zh: 这座城市里到处都能看到报摊。

sentences.en: The hungry cat scattered the trash all over the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 那只饿猫把厨房里的垃圾都撒了一地。

sentences.en: Pieces of the broken mirror lay scattered on the floor.
sentences.zh: 破碎的镜子碎片散落在地板上。

senses.zh: 使散开，使分散；使散射；使散播，使撒播 -
